selection: Fixed clone IDs inherited from frozen main plan; ROI1 center as reference and ROI4 southwest chosen from the previously reported ~10-minute limiting margin. Outcome-informed point selection is explicit and not independent confirmation. No clone outcomes read before this plan.

semantics.section: Section 3 and Figure 11: observation-filtered minus simulated terrain gives Z error, added to original LDEM to construct a clone. Downloaded official filenames end in _err.tif; near-zero values and GeoTIFF metadata are also checked.
semantics.units: Z metres; planar XY metres; 5 m raster spacing
semantics.referenceFrame: MOON_ME DE421, south polar stereographic; radius 1737400 m
semantics.missingData: Any missing or nonfinite clone field inside nominal valid local terrain makes that clone unknown, never zero. A failed source or point query retains both planned point records as unknown where applicable.
semantics.sign: Add signed official Z error to the original surface; positive raises surface height. Observer and all local horizon samples use that same realization.
semantics.spatialCorrelation: Use complete official raster without reshuffling, independent pixel noise or RMS-to-angle conversion. Preserve joint local ground/occluder field.
semantics.observer: Each clone observer elevation = bilinear original surface + bilinear same error field, then +2 m. Exact changed elevation sent to Horizons for separate 5-minute Sun/Earth predictions.
semantics.regionalBoundary: Only Site01 local errors represented. Outside local tile use fixed regional DEM; no regional covariance is available. Product seam and far-field errors remain unknown.

limits: 5 of 100 official realizations, selected by fixed ID: no probabilities, quantiles or confidence coverage.
2 of 18 prior audited locations only: no claim about nine-point whole-footprint worst case.
Same source model and own runner; not independent external validation.
0.5 degree azimuth, refined radial sampling; finite ray/DEM and 5-minute cadence limitations remain.
